HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 04.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 34964/2025 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition is filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of FIR No. 187/2022 dated 12.02.2022, registered at police station Malviya Nagar for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') including the proceedings emanating therefrom.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during the course of arguments on charge, an application is moved by the prosecution for further investigation.
He submits that the petitioner during the course of investigation had also produced number of documents before the Investigating Officer which This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/12/2025 at 21:42:07 clearly indicates that the allegations made by the complainant were wrong in regard to the demand of dowry and cruelty.

5. sentences.text: He submits that no prejudice will be caused since an application has been filed by the State itself for further investigation.
6. Issue notice.
7. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

8. Let a copy of the application filed before the learned Trial Court by the prosecution, be placed on record before the next date of hearing.
9.
